name: Greater Deadly Accuracy (Combat)
body:
Your aim is nearly preternatural in its effectiveness.

Prerequisite: Dex 15, Deadly Accuracy, BAB +9.

Benefit: As Deadly Accuracy, except you can reroll any natural 1 or 2 on damage for your Dexterity-based weapons. You must keep the result of the reroll, even if it is another 1 or 2.
